declarations.signature: payment_ledger.Principal → payment_ledger.Command → Option (List (H5iAppLib.Query.Read payment_ledger.Schema.Val))
declarations.definition:
fun a x =>
  match x with
  | payment_ledger.Command.Open owner a a_1 a_2 a_3 =>
    some [{ table := 2, pred := H5iAppLib.Query.Pred.all }, { table := 3, pred := payment_ledger.Plan.eqU 0 owner }]
  | payment_ledger.Command.Transfer t =>
    some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_ledger.Plan.accsA t }, { table := 1, pred := payment_ledger.Plan.eqU 0 t.id }]
  | payment_ledger.Command.Batch ts =>
    match ↑ts with
    | [] => some []
    | t0 :: rest => if (↑ts).length > 64 then some [] else some (payment_ledger.Plan.batchA t0 rest)
  | payment_ledger.Command.Account id => some [{ table := 0, pred := payment_ledger.Plan.eqU 0 id }]
  | payment_ledger.Command.Accounts owner f l =>
    if ↑l ≠ 0 ∧ ↑l ≤ 64 ∧ (a.operator = true ∨ owner = a.user) then
      some (payment_ledger.Plan.pageA owner (↑f) (payment_ledger.Plan.pageEndN ↑f ↑l))
    else some []
  | payment_ledger.Command.Transfers acc f l =>
    if ↑l ≠ 0 ∧ ↑l ≤ 4096 ∧ a.operator = true then
      some (payment_ledger.Plan.journalA acc (↑f) (payment_ledger.Plan.pageEndN ↑f ↑l))
    else some []
  | payment_ledger.Command.AccountRange f l =>
    if ↑l ≠ 0 ∧ ↑l ≤ 4096 ∧ a.operator = true then
      some (payment_ledger.Plan.idsA (↑f) (payment_ledger.Plan.pageEndN ↑f ↑l))
    else some []
  | payment_ledger.Command.History acc f l =>
    if ↑l ≠ 0 ∧ ↑l ≤ 64 ∧ a.operator = true then
      some (payment_ledger.Plan.histA acc (↑f) (payment_ledger.Plan.pageEndN ↑f ↑l))
    else some []
  | payment_ledger.Command.TransferRange f l =>
    if ↑l ≠ 0 ∧ ↑l ≤ 4096 ∧ a.operator = true then
      some (payment_ledger.Plan.tidsA (↑f) (payment_ledger.Plan.pageEndN ↑f ↑l))
    else some []

    { next := s.next, accounts := H5iAppLib.upsert (fun x => x.id) a s.accounts, transfers := s.transfers,
      owners := s.owners, history := s.history }
  | payment_ledger.Write.PutTransfer t =>

      owners := s.owners, history := s.history }
  | payment_ledger.Write.SetLedger l =>
    { next := ↑l.next_account, accounts := s.accounts, transfers := s.transfers, owners := s.owners,
      history := s.history }
  | payment_ledger.Write.PutOwner c =>
    { next := s.next, accounts := s.accounts, transfers := s.transfers,
      owners := H5iAppLib.upsert (fun x => x.owner) c s.owners, history := s.history }
  | payment_ledger.Write.PutHistory h =>
    { next := s.next, accounts := s.accounts, transfers := s.transfers, owners := s.owners,
      history := H5iAppLib.upsert (fun y => (y.account, y.n)) h s.history }

declarations.name: Models.execKeyed
declarations.signature:
{P St C R : Type} →
  Models.Kernel P St C R →
    [DecidableEq C] →
      (P → String) →
        Models.Db St →
          Models.Replies C R → P → String → C → Prod (Models.Db St) (Prod (Models.Replies C R) (Models.Keyed R))
declarations.definition:
fun {P St C R} K [DecidableEq C] scope db st a k c =>
  have key := (K.tenant a, scope a, k);
  match st key with
  | some (c', r) => if c' = c then (db, st, Models.Keyed.replayed r) else (db, st, Models.Keyed.conflict)
  | none =>
    match Models.exec K db a c with
    | (db', some r) => (db', Function.update st key (some (c, r)), Models.Keyed.ran (some r))
    | (db', none) => (db', st, Models.Keyed.ran none)
